description: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Teachers' Service 3rd Amendment
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Teachers' Service, specifically detailing efficiency bar examinations, promotion criteria, and performance evaluation procedures for teachers. This falls under public sector service administration, recruitment conditions, and service regulations, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover public service recruitment, examinations, service conditions, and administrative instructions for public sector employees.
